name: France
Description: The Eiffel Tower is one of the most iconic landmarks in the world. It offers stunning views of Paris from its observation decks and is a must-visit attraction for tourists.
Address: Champ de Mars, 5 Avenue Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France

name: France
Description: The Louvre is the world's largest art museum and a historic monument in Paris, France. It is home to thousands of works of art, including the Mona Lisa and the Venus de Milo.
Entry Fee: €15 for adults, free for children under 18

name: France
Description: The Palace of Versailles is a former royal residence located in Versailles, France. It is known for its opulent architecture, beautiful gardens, and rich history.
Entry Fee: €18 for adults, free for children under 18

name: France
Description: The Promenade des Anglais is a famous seaside promenade in Nice, France. It offers scenic views of the Mediterranean Sea and is a popular spot for walking, jogging, and cycling.

name: France
Description: The Musee Matisse is a museum in Nice, France, dedicated to the works of the French artist Henri Matisse. It houses a collection of his paintings, sculptures, and drawings.
Entry Fee: €10 for adults, free for children under 18
Address: 164 Avenue des Arènes de Cimiez, 06000 Nice, France

name: Spain
Description: The Sagrada Família is a large unfinished Roman Catholic basilica in Barcelona, Spain. Designed by Antoni Gaudí, it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a stunning example of modernist architecture.

name: Spain
Description: The Prado Museum is the main Spanish national art museum, located in Madrid. It is widely considered to have one of the finest collections of European art, dating from the 12th century to the early 20th century.
Entry Fee: €15 for adults, free for children under 18
Address: Calle de Ruiz de Alarcón, 23, 28014 Madrid, Spain

name: Spain
Description: Plaza de España is a large square in the city of Seville, Spain. It is a popular tourist destination known for its impressive architecture and beautiful tiled fountains.
Address: Av de Isabel la Católica, 41004 Sevilla, Spain

name: Spain
Description: Park Güell is a public park system composed of gardens and architectural elements located on Carmel Hill, in Barcelona, Spain. It was designed by the architect Antoni Gaudí and built from 1900 to 1914.
Entry Fee: €10 for adults, free for children under 7

name: Spain
Description: The Alhambra is a palace and fortress complex located in Granada, Andalusia, Spain. It is one of the most famous monuments of Islamic architecture and one of the best-preserved palaces of the historic Islamic world.
Entry Fee: €14 for adults, free for children under 12
Address: Calle Real de la Alhambra, s/n, 18009 Granada, Spain

name: US
Description: The Statue of Liberty is a colossal neoclassical sculpture on Liberty Island in New York Harbor, representing freedom and democracy. It was a gift from the people of France to the United States.
Address: Liberty Island, New York, NY 10004, USA

name: US
Description: The Golden Gate Bridge is a suspension bridge spanning the Golden Gate, the strait connecting San Francisco Bay and the Pacific Ocean. It is an internationally recognized symbol of San Francisco, California, and the United States.

name: US
Description: The Hollywood Walk of Fame is a historic landmark consisting of more than 2,600 five-pointed terrazzo and brass stars embedded in the sidewalks along 15 blocks of Hollywood Boulevard in Hollywood, California.
Address: Hollywood Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90028, USA

name: US
Description: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in Wyoming, Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872.

name: US
Description: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. It is one of the world's most famous natural landmarks and offers breathtaking views.

name: China
Description: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications made of stone, brick, tamped earth, wood, and other materials, generally built along an east-to-west line across the historical northern borders of China.

name: China
Description: The Bund is a waterfront area in central Shanghai. The area centers on a section of Zhongshan Road within the former Shanghai International Settlement, which runs along the western bank of the Huangpu River.

name: China
Description: The Terracotta Army is a collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang, the first Emperor of China. It is a form of funerary art buried with the emperor in 210–209 BCE.

name: China
Description: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park is a unique national forest park located in Zhangjiajie City in Hunan Province, China. It is known for its towering sandstone pillars and scenic beauty.
Address: Wulingyuan Scenic Area, Zhangjiajie, Hunan, China

name: China
Description: Jiuzhaigou Valley is a nature reserve and national park located in the northern part of Sichuan Province, China. It is known for its multi-level waterfalls, colorful lakes, and snow-capped peaks. The valley's name means "Nine Village Valley," and it is home to nine Tibetan villages. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a popular tourist destination.
Address: Jiuzhaigou Valley, Aba Tibetan Qiang Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan, China

name: Italy
Description: The Colosseum is an ancient amphitheater in the center of Rome, Italy. It is the largest ancient amphitheater ever built, and it is still the largest standing amphitheater in the world. The Colosseum could hold, it is estimated, between 50,000 and 80,000 spectators, who watched gladiatorial contests and other public spectacles.
Entry Fee: €16 for adults, €2 for EU citizens (18-25), free for children under 18
Address: Piazza del Colosseo, 1, 00184 Roma RM, Italy

name: Italy
Description: St. Mark's Basilica is the cathedral church of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Venice, northern Italy. It is one of the best-known examples of Italo-Byzantine architecture. The basilica is known for its opulent design, gold ground mosaics, and its status as a symbol of Venetian wealth and power.
Entry Fee: Free entry, €5 for access to the museum
Address: Piazza San Marco, 328, 30100 Venezia VE, Italy

name: Italy
Description: The Uffizi Gallery is a prominent art museum located adjacent to the Piazza della Signoria in the Historic Centre of Florence in the region of Tuscany, Italy. One of the most important Italian museums, it holds a collection of priceless works, particularly from the period of the Italian Renaissance.
Entry Fee: €20 for adults, €2 for EU citizens (18-25), free for children under 18
Address: Piazzale degli Uffizi, 6, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

name: Italy
Description: The Amalfi Coast is a stretch of coastline along the southern edge of Italy's Sorrentine Peninsula, in the Campania region. It's a popular holiday destination, known for its rugged terrain, scenic beauty, and picturesque towns. The coastline is dotted with small beaches and pastel-colored fishing villages.

name: Italy
Description: Pompeii is an ancient city located near Naples in the Campania region of Italy. It was buried under volcanic ash and pumice in the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD. The city has been preserved for centuries and offers a unique glimpse into Roman life.
Entry Fee: €16 for adults, €2 for EU citizens (18-25), free for children under 18
Address: Via Villa dei Misteri, 2, 80045 Pompei NA, Italy

name: Turkey
Description: Hagia Sophia is a historic mosque and former Greek Orthodox Christian patriarchal cathedral, later an Ottoman imperial mosque and now a museum in Istanbul, Turkey. It is famous for its large dome, regarded as the epitome of Byzantine architecture and is said to have "changed the history of architecture."
Address: Sultan Ahmet, Ayasofya Meydani, 34122 Fatih/Istanbul, Turkey

name: Turkey
Description: The Göreme Open-Air Museum is a site that contains the finest of the rock-cut churches, with beautiful frescoes (wall paintings) that date back to the 10th, 11th, and 12th centuries. The museum is located in Cappadocia, a region famous for its unique landscape of fairy chimneys and cave dwellings.
Entry Fee: 100 TL for adults, 50 TL for children

name: Turkey
Description: The Antalya Museum is one of Turkey's largest museums, located in Antalya. It contains 13 exhibition halls and an open-air gallery with works of art and artifacts from the region's history. It is particularly renowned for its collection of statues from the Roman period.
Entry Fee: 50 TL for adults, free for children under 18

name: Turkey
Description: Pamukkale, meaning "cotton castle" in Turkish, is a natural site in Denizli in southwestern Turkey. The area is famous for a carbonate mineral left by the flowing water, creating terraces and warm, turquoise pools. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Entry Fee: 80 TL for adults, 40 TL for children

name: Turkey
Description: Mount Nemrut is a high mountain in southeastern Turkey, famous for the summit where large statues are erected around what is assumed to be a royal tomb from the 1st century BC. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a popular destination for tourists.
Entry Fee: 20 TL for adults, 10 TL for children

name: Mexico
Description: Chichén Itzá is a large pre-Columbian archaeological site built by the Maya civilization located in the Yucatán Peninsula, Mexico. It is one of the most visited archaeological sites in Mexico and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The pyramid of El Castillo is a recognizable symbol of Chichén Itzá.
Entry Fee: $481 MXN for adults, $80 MXN for children

name: Mexico
Description: The Palacio de Bellas Artes is a prominent cultural center in Mexico City. The building is renowned for its architectural style, murals by famous Mexican artists, and performances including ballet, opera, and symphonic music.
Address: Av. Juárez, Centro Histórico, 06050 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico

name: Mexico
Description: The Hospicio Cabañas, located in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, is one of the oldest and largest hospital complexes in the Americas. The building is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is famous for its architecture and murals by José Clemente Orozco.
Entry Fee: $70 MXN for adults, free for children under 12
Address: Cabañas 8, Las Fresas, 44360 Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico

name: Mexico
Description: Tulum is a town on the Caribbean coastline of Mexico’s Yucatán Peninsula. It’s known for its well-preserved ruins of an ancient Mayan port city. The Tulum ruins are situated on 12-meter-tall cliffs along the east coast of the Yucatán Peninsula on the Caribbean Sea.
Entry Fee: $80 MXN for adults, free for children under 12

name: Mexico
Description: The Copper Canyon is a group of six canyons in the state of Chihuahua, Mexico. The canyons were formed by six rivers that drain the western side of the Sierra Tarahumara. The Copper Canyon is larger and deeper than the Grand Canyon in the US.

name: UK
Description: The Tower of London is a historic castle on the north bank of the River Thames in central London. It is famous for housing the Crown Jewels, its historical significance as a royal palace, and its function as a prison.

name: UK
Description: Edinburgh Castle is a historic fortress which dominates the skyline of Edinburgh, Scotland. It has been a royal residence, a military stronghold, and now is a major tourist attraction. The castle houses the Crown Jewels and the Stone of Destiny.

name: UK
Description: The Roman Baths are a well-preserved thermae in the city of Bath, Somerset, England. They are a major tourist attraction and house ancient Roman artifacts and architecture. The baths were used for public bathing in Roman times.
Address: Abbey Church Yard, Bath BA1 1LZ, United Kingdom

name: UK
Description: The Lake District is a mountainous region in North West England. A popular holiday destination, it is known for its glacial ribbon lakes, rugged fell mountains, and historic literary associations. The area is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: UK
Description: Stonehenge is a prehistoric monument in Wiltshire, England. It consists of a ring of standing stones, each around 13 feet high, seven feet wide, and weighing around 25 tons. It is one of the most famous landmarks in the UK.

name: Germany
Description: The Brandenburg Gate is an 18th-century neoclassical monument in Berlin, Germany. One of the best-known landmarks of Germany, it was built on the orders of Prussian king Frederick William II after the temporary restoration of order during the Batavian Revolution.

name: Germany
Description: Marienplatz is a central square in the city centre of Munich, Germany. Since 1158, it has been the city's main square and serves as the heart of the city's festivities, cultural events, and historical moments.

name: Germany
Description: Heidelberg Castle is a ruin in Germany and landmark of Heidelberg. The castle has only been partially rebuilt since its demolition in the 17th and 18th centuries. It is a popular tourist destination and cultural site.

name: Germany
Description: The Black Forest is a large forested mountain range in the state of Baden-Württemberg in southwest Germany. It is known for its dense woods, picturesque villages, and outdoor activities like hiking and skiing.

name: Germany
Description: Neuschwanstein Castle, a fairy tale-like castle located in Bavaria, Germany, was commissioned by Ludwig II of Bavaria. It is known for its picturesque architecture and scenic location, serving as an inspiration for Disney's Sleeping Beauty Castle.
Entry Fee: €13 for adults, €12 for students, free for children under 18

name: Greece
Description: The Acropolis of Athens is an ancient citadel located on a rocky outcrop above the city of Athens. It contains the remains of several ancient buildings of great architectural and historic significance, the most famous being the Parthenon.

name: Greece
Description: Oia is a coastal town on the northwestern tip of Santorini, Greece. It is known for its stunning sunsets, white-washed buildings, and breathtaking views of the caldera. Oia is a popular destination for tourists and photographers.

name: Greece
Description: Mykonos Town, also known as Chora, is the capital and largest town of the Greek island of Mykonos. It is known for its vibrant nightlife, picturesque streets, and iconic windmills. Mykonos is a popular destination for both beach lovers and partygoers.

name: Greece
Description: Delphi is an ancient archaeological site in Greece and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It was once considered the center of the world in ancient Greek religion, home to the Oracle of Delphi and the Temple of Apollo.

name: Greece
Description: Meteora is a rock formation in central Greece hosting one of the largest and most precipitously built complexes of Eastern Orthodox monasteries. It is included on the UNESCO World Heritage List. The monasteries are perched atop high cliffs, providing stunning views.
